text: Kan extensions are 'best approximations' to extending a functor along an inclusion. They are the most general notion for:
choices: computing limits and colimits (both can be expressed as Kan extensions)
building functors between Set and Top
explanation: Kan (1958): 'All concepts are Kan extensions.' Limits, colimits, adjunctions, and even Yoneda can be expressed as (pointwise) Kan extensions.
